Faction.Name: Eden Commerce Guild
Faction.Description: The Trading Guild is a collection of large corporations, formed after the Great Galactic War, in an effort to encourage trade and commerce to avoid a second war.

Faction.Name: Ozark Confederal Territories
Faction.Description: The once powerful, galaxy-spanning Ozark Empire was defeated after the Great Galactic War, and subsequently splintered into many different territories and factions, the largest of which is the Ozark Confederal Territories. They dream of one day uniting themselves and taking revenge on the coalition that ended their empire.
